byResourceType.description_en: Grouped by inventory resource type, this data reveals emissions details for each category. It serves the "By type" analysis in the composition breakdown. A nested structure is employed: total carbon emissions are organized first by inventory type, forming a two-level hierarchy, with the innermost level 'byResource' currently empty
byResourceType.description_zh: 按类型聚合，各中类型的排放详情。用于组成分析中的“按类型”分析。这是一个嵌套结构，总碳排放量->按清单类型排序，共两层，最末级byResource为空

items.description_en: Aggregates the inventory list by resource type
items.description_zh: 按类型聚合列表。按类型聚合，各中类型的排放详情。用于组成分析中的“按类型”分析。这是一个嵌套结构，总碳排放量->按清单类型排序，共两层，最末级byResource为空

byResourceType.title: 按类型聚合列表

items.description_en: Organized hierarchically, it cascades from high to low: flow-> process-> inventory level. Employed for "By inventory" analysis in compositional breakdowns, the innermost layer of this nested structure is empty
items.description_zh: 按层级从高到低的结构组织，按照环节->工序->清单层级。用于组成分析中的“按清单”分析。这是一个嵌套结构，按照环节->工序->清单层级，最末层级items为空
构成详情列表。按层级从高到低的结构组织，按照环节->工序->清单层级。用于组成分析中的“按清单”分析。这是一个嵌套结构，按照环节->工序->清单层级，最末层级items为空

items.title: 构成详情列表

percent.description_en: Percentage of emissions, for example 100.00 means 100.00%

resourceType.title: 清单类型

GwpResourceConstitute.description_en: Carbon emission structure of gwp inventory

carbonEmission.description_en: The carbon emissions. To ensure accuracy, retain 24 decimal places. We recommend that you intercept the carbon emissions
carbonEmission.description_zh: 碳排放量，为保证精度，保留24位小数，建议截取使用
carbonEmission.title: 碳排放当量

name.description_en: Name signifies a concept with distinct layers of meaning, where the outermost layer represents the overall carbon emissions
name.description_zh: 名称，逐层含义不同，最外层是总碳排放量
name.title: 名称

percent.description_en: Percentage of emissions. 98.76 indicates the proportion of 98.76%
percent.description_zh: 排放百分比。98.76的表示98.76%的占比
percent.title: 排放百分比

resourceType.description_en: The type of the inventory. It is meaningful at the inventory layer and can be empty at other layers
resourceType.description_zh: 清单类型。在清单层有意义，其它层可为空
resourceType.title: 清单类型

GwpResourceConstitute.title: 资源构成结构体

description_en: Retrieves the carbon emission composition analysis for a specified product. The analysis provides a breakdown across two dimensions: by checklist and by type. The results are rendered as a hierarchical list and a pie chart
description_zh: 用于获取指定产品的碳排放构成分析。碳排放构成分析包括按清单、按类型两种分析维度。在呈现效果上，包括一个层级列表和饼状图
name: GetGwpInventoryConstitute

parameters.help_en: The product type. A value of 1 indicates a request for a product carbon footprint. A value of 5 indicates a request for a supply chain carbon footprint
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型：1表示请求产品碳足迹，5表示请求供应链碳足迹
parameters.name: product_type

byResourceType.description_en: Aggregated by type. This includes the emission details for each type
byResourceType.description_zh: 按类型聚合，各种类型的排放详情

items.description_en: Used for the 'by type' analysis. This is a two-level nested structure. The top level is Total Carbon Emissions, which is then sorted by checklist type. The byResourceType parameter at the lowest level is empty
items.description_zh: 用于组成分析中的“按类型”分析。这是一个嵌套结构，总碳排放量->按清单类型排序，共两层，最末级byResourceType为空

carbonEmission.description_en: The amount of emissions. The value can be positive, negative, or 0. To ensure calculation accuracy, the calculation process retains 24 decimal places. For ease of display and use, truncate the value as needed
carbonEmission.description_zh: 排放数量：可能为正数、负数、0。为保证计算精度，计算过程保留24位小数，为方便显示和使用，建议根据业务需要进行截取

items.description_en: Organized in a hierarchical structure from the highest level to the lowest level: stage, procedure, and then checklist
items.description_zh: 按层级从高到低的结构组织，按照环节->工序->清单层级

items.description_en: Used for the 'by checklist' analysis. This is a nested structure organized by stage, procedure, and checklist level. The items parameter at the lowest level is empty
items.description_zh: 用于组成分析中的“按清单”分析。是一个嵌套结构，按照环节->工序->清单层级，最末层级items为空

name.description_en: The meaning of the current hierarchical structure

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Each request has a unique value. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题
